description: Additional EU laws for Study 2 (combined corpus with GDPR Chapters I-V), chosen by the inclusion criterion in docs/C3_V2_DEVELOPMENT.md section 5. Official English text as published in the Official Journal (original version, not consolidated).
version_note: The originally published versions are used deliberately, as for the CRD/LPD (Study 1) and the GDPR. Later amendments and consolidated versions (e.g. Directive 2007/30/EC and Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 amending Directive 89/391/EEC) were deliberately not used.
format_note: Same format as data/knowledge/sources.json (list key 'directives', so the same DirectiveChunker can read it). Extra fields: format, entry_into_force, application (both quoted from the official text). For ECD and OSH, CELLAR holds no XHTML (HTTP 404 'does not hold a content datastream of the requested type'); the only text manifestation is the legacy EUR-Lex HTML (Accept: text/html). It has no article markup, so src/legacy_html_study2_laws.py adds that markup in memory before the unchanged DirectiveChunker reads it; the raw file is never changed.
download_method: curl from the Publications Office CELLAR repository (the official store behind EUR-Lex), requesting the English text by CELEX number with headers 'Accept: application/xhtml+xml' and 'Accept-Language: eng' (same method as data/knowledge/sources.json). For ECD and OSH, where no XHTML exists, 'Accept: text/html' was requested instead.

directives.full_title: Directive 2000/31/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 June 2000 on certain legal aspects of information society services, in particular electronic commerce, in the Internal Market ('Directive on electronic commerce')

entry_into_force.source: Article 23: 'This Directive shall enter into force on the day of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Communities.' (OJ L 178, 17.7.2000)

application.source: Article 22(1): Member States shall bring into force the laws ... necessary to comply with this Directive 'before 17 January 2002'.

directives.short_name: Transparent and Predictable Working Conditions Directive
directives.full_title: Directive (EU) 2019/1152 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 on transparent and predictable working conditions in the European Union

entry_into_force.source: Article 25: 'on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal' (published 11.7.2019).

application.source: Article 21(1): 'Member States shall take the necessary measures to comply with this Directive by 1 August 2022.'

directives.full_title: Directive (EU) 2023/2225 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 18 October 2023 on credit agreements for consumers and repealing Directive 2008/48/EC

entry_into_force.source: Article 49: 'on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal' (published 30.10.2023).

application.source: Article 48(1): Member States adopt and publish the measures by 20 November 2025 and 'shall apply those measures from 20 November 2026'.

directives.full_title: Council Directive 89/391/EEC of 12 June 1989 on the introduction of measures to encourage improvements in the safety and health of workers at work

entry_into_force.source: The text has no entry-into-force article; Article 19: 'This Directive is addressed to the Member States.' (a directive of that time took effect on notification to the Member States; the notification date is not in the text).

application.source: Article 18(1): Member States shall bring into force the laws ... necessary to comply with this Directive 'by 31 December 1992'.
